这是一个非常简单的 ComfyUI 初学者友好的文本到图像工作流程，可与 Lumina 2 ALL-in-One 模型配合使用，该模型将文本编码器和 VAE 烘焙到单个文件中。另外，对于此工作流程，我还添加了我最近的 Easy Prompt Saver 调整，因此此工作流程还可以帮助您将文本到图像生成数据保存到人类可读的 .txt 文件中。此外，如果您愿意，通过在此使用 Image Saver Simple 节点，您可以将元数据和工作流程本身嵌入到已保存的图像上，或者单独保存工作流程。

在此工作流程中，您不必像 Lumina2 团队的示例工作流程那样为 Lumina2 输入尴尬的提示初始化字符串，例如此字符串 - "您是一位高级图像生成助手，旨在生成高质量的逼真图像，专门用于创建高度详细、高分辨率的摄影，精确匹配用户提示（包括基于标签的提示）。 <立即开始>", 我以 ComfyUI 处理 Lumina2 提示初始化的方式制作了这个工作流程，您只需要关注自己的自然语言提示即可。

Lumina2由上海人工智能实验室与学术界和初创公司合作伙伴共同开发，于2025年1月发布，开创了2025年11月发布的Z-Image后来完善的技术先例。 Lumina 2 是一种具有 26 亿参数的人工智能模型，用于从文本生成图像，建立在统一的“单流”架构之上，将文本和图像作为一个连续的数据流进行处理，以实现完美同步。阿里巴巴的 Z-Image 分享了这一核心设计，使它们成为平衡家用计算机的紧凑尺寸和速度的紧密竞争对手。 Lumina2 可以充分处理基本的图像中文本任务，而 Z-Image 在复杂、准确的排版方面尤其擅长，尤其是英文和中文双语文本，使其更适合专业图形 效果图。

您可以从 HuggingFace 下载所需的 Lumina ALL-in-One 模型，并从 CivitAI 下载此工作流程中使用的 LORA（详细信息如下所述）。确保您安装了足够最新的 ComfyUI，并使用 ComfyUI 管理器安装此工作流程所需的任何节点，并将正确的文件（AIO 模型、LORA 等）放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的其他工作流程、LORA、工具集、SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、Illustrious、WAN 2.1、WAN 2.2、MagicWAN Image v2、QWEN、HunyuanImage-2.1、HiDream、KREA、Chroma、AuraFlow、Z-Image Base & Turbo、Flux.2 Klein 和 Flux.1 Dev 的数据集。随意在您喜欢的东西上扔一些黄色的嗡嗡声。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需首先选择您想要的 Lumina 2 ALL-in-One 模型文件即可

#2.设置您想要的图像尺寸开始

＃3。然后输入你的正面和负面提示。

＃4。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置（强烈建议您使用默认设置）

＃6。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

** 此工作流程的 LORA 使用是可选的，您可以在没有任何 LORA 的情况下使用它，也可以与 1 或 2 个或任何其他数量的 LORA 一起使用，要添加新的 LORA，请按顶部的 L 按钮在新选项卡上的 LORA Manager 中找到您的 LORA，如果您想使用该 LORA，只需单击向上的 Kite 按钮。

o.en:
This is a very simple ComfyUI beginner friendly Text-to-Image workflow that will work with Lumina 2 ALL-in-One model that has both Text Encoder & VAE baked into just a single file. Also for this workflow I have included my recent Easy Prompt Saver tweak so this workflow also helps you to save your Text to Image Generation Data into a human readable .txt file. Also, if you want, with the Image Saver Simple node used on this you may embed the metadata with workflow itself on the saved image or save the workflow on it's own.

On this workflow you don't have to type the awkward prompt initialization string for Lumina2 like the example workflow from the Lumina2 team, like this string - "You are an advanced image generation assistant designed to generate high-quality realistic images, specialized in creating highly detailed, high-resolution photography that precisely matches user prompts, including tag-based prompts. <Prompt Start>", I made this workflow in a way that ComfyUI handles the Lumina2 prompt initialization, you only need to focus on your own natural language prompt.

Developed by the Shanghai AI Laboratory with academic and startup partners, Lumina2 was released in January 2025, setting the technological precedent that Z-Image, released in November 2025, later refined. Lumina 2 is a 2.6-billion-parameter AI model for generating images from text, built on a unified "single-stream" architecture that processes text and images as one continuous data flow for perfect synchronization. Z-Image by Alibaba, shares this core design, making them close rivals that balance compact size and speed for home computers. While Lumina2 handles basic text-in-image tasks adequately, Z-Image excels specifically at complex, accurate typography—especially bilingual English and Chinese text—making it superior for professional graphic renderings.

You can download your necessary Lumina ALL-in-One model from HuggingFace and LORA used on this workflow from CivitAI (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you have latest enough ComfyUI installation and install any necessary nodes for this workflow using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files (AIO model, LORAs etc) in correct places. Also check out my other workflows, LORAs, toolsets, datasets for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, Illustrious, WAN 2.1, WAN 2.2, MagicWAN Image v2, QWEN, HunyuanImage-2.1, HiDream, KREA, Chroma, AuraFlow, Z-Image Base & Turbo, Flux.2 Klein and Flux.1 Dev. Feel free to toss some yellow Buzz on stuffs you like.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired Lumina 2 ALL-in-One model file first and now

#2. set your desired image dimensions to start

#3. then input your positive and negative prompts.

#4. select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings (It's highly advisd that you use the default settings)

#6. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

** LORA usage for this workflow is optional you can use it without any LORAs, use with 1 or 2 or any other number of LORAs, to add new LORAs press the L button on top to lunch LORA Manager on a new tab find your LORA and if you want to use that LORA just click the upward Kite button.
